mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (post_id, user_id, parent_id, root_id, reply_user_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{rootId}, #{replyUserId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT id, post_id, user_id, parent_id, root_id, reply_user_id, content, like_count, status, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM comment WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT c.id, c.post_id AS postId, c.user_id AS userId, c.content, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.root_id AS rootId, c.reply_user_id AS replyUserId, c.like_count AS likeCount, c.create_time AS createTime, u.nickname AS authorNickname, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c2 WHERE c2.post_id = c.post_id AND c2.root_id = c.id AND c2.deleted = 0) AS replyCount FROM comment c LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.root_id = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT c.id, c.post_id AS postId, c.user_id AS userId, c.content, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.root_id AS rootId, c.reply_user_id AS replyUserId, c.like_count AS likeCount, c.create_time AS createTime, u.nickname AS authorNickname, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, ru.nickname AS replyUserNickname FROM comment c LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN `user` ru ON ru.id = c.reply_user_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.root_id = #{rootId} AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time ASC, c.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET deleted = 1, status = 2 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
